description: pkix-revocation/tests/crl_checker_tests.rs:255-410 — The delta CRL tests correctly use a separate CA (CN=Test Delta CRL CA, serial=200) distinct from the base CRL tests (CN=Test CRL CA, serial=100). However no test verifies that a delta CRL from one CA is rejected when used with a base CRL from a different CA (cross-CA attack). The with_delta constructor does check issuer DN matching, but there is no test that constructs a CrlChecker::with_delta(base-from-ca-A, delta-from-ca-B, ...) and asserts DeltaCrlBaseMismatch. Without this test the issuer-mismatch check is not exercised for the cross-CA path.
title: delta CRL tests use same CA as existing CRL tests — cross-CA isolation not verified
